synopsis: Chapter 12 and the glossary state that the U.S. Department of Defense requires a Test and Evaluation Master Plan (TEMP) for major programmes, citing DoD Instruction 5000.89 of November 2020 and TEMP Guidebook version 3.1 of January 2017 [f9546, f16407]. Chapter 12 also associates TEMP / IDSK with that instruction and guidebook, without explaining IDSK’s role [f10039]. The supplied facts agree on the TEMP requirement but do not establish whether it applies to the heavy off-road machine validation project [f9546, f16407, f10039].

relations.note: Both state the same TEMP requirement and cite identical instruction and guidebook dates.
Adds IDSK to the TEMP association with the instruction and guidebook.
